p1.tell: The original said "some think" — the crop turns speculation into certainty.
p1.explanation: The NPR piece reported that some researchers believe they may have found evidence of dinosaur blood, not that they definitively have. Removing "some think" presents a tentative finding as a confirmed discovery.
p1.con_line_fooled: I didn't change a single word. I just stopped quoting early.
p1.con_line_caught: You read the whole sentence. How thorough. How annoying.

diff.shown: Scientists have studied plenty of dinosaur bones, eggs and footprints. Now, they've found their strongest evidence yet of dinosaur blood.
diff.original: Scientists have studied plenty of dinosaur bones, eggs and footprints. Now, some think they've found their strongest evidence yet of dinosaur blood.
